strings.name: Angelina Jolie
strings.summary: Born into a Los Angeles acting family, Jolie developed into an action and dramatic performer, winning an Oscar for Girl, Interrupted. She directs war and family stories and has long visited refugees and conflict regions. UNHCR goodwill ambassador then special envoy from 2001 to 2022, she continued humanitarian advocacy after leaving, focusing on displacement, children in war and sexual violence.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Gained public influence through acting, directing and long refugee humanitarian work, raising awareness of children in war and displaced people.
